heroHeadline: Saudi Coalition Hits Houthi Yemen With Dozens of Strikes as Pakistan's FO Calls Mecca Pact an "Umbrella Agreement," Not Yet Operational
heroSubtitle: Following the Sep 8 Houthi barrage that wounded 73 Saudis, Saudi-backed coalition forces struck a Houthi-run prison in al-Hazm on Sep 9 — killing 23 — and conducted roughly 32 further strikes across four Yemeni provinces overnight into Sep 10. Defence Minister Khawaja Asif warned Iran and the Houthis against exploiting US-Iran tensions to draw Saudi Arabia deeper into conflict "at its own peril," but Pakistan's Foreign Office clarified Sep 11 that the Makkah pact remains an unoperationalized "umbrella agreement" with no Pakistani military role under discussion, while Turkey's Fidan stressed any assistance would depend on circumstances and a formal request. No signatory has invoked the pact or joined the retaliation militarily.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
